LanguageData.INH_MaintenanceEnableHint: Allows new daily food plans for stored occupants. Existing plans continue charging when disabled; stop a plan to stop its charges. Food accounting only: ordinary hunger, health, aging and production remain frozen.
LanguageData.INH_MaintenanceHelp: Manage daily food charges for colonists and animals already stored at delegated sites. Use delegated management to store occupants or return them to their original caravan.
LanguageData.INH_MaintenanceFrozenWarning: Food charges only. Stored colonists and animals' ordinary hunger, health, aging and production remain frozen; this does not simulate their daily life.
LanguageData.INH_MaintenanceNoSites: No delegated site is registered. This screen does not create a site, pawn or caravan.
LanguageData.INH_MaintenanceDisabled: Enable maintenance in the mod settings to start a new plan. Existing daily charges continue when disabled. You can still stop or resume plans and recover unfinished charges.
LanguageData.INH_MaintenanceFoodHelp: Charges use eligible food in each stored occupant's own inventory. Available food and daily demand are shown in nutrition units.
LanguageData.INH_MaintenanceReadUnavailable: The site or its stored occupants could not be read. Reopen this screen after checking the game state.
LanguageData.INH_MaintenanceNoResidents: No stored occupants or maintenance plans at this site.
LanguageData.INH_MaintenanceNutrition: Available food: {0} nutrition · daily demand: {1} nutrition
LanguageData.INH_MaintenancePending: Unfinished food charges at this site
LanguageData.INH_MaintenanceNoPending: No food charges are waiting for completion.
LanguageData.INH_MaintenanceProblem_Unlocated: This older site has no registered world location. Daily maintenance cannot start here.
LanguageData.INH_MaintenanceProblem_AnchorMissing: The original caravan is missing. No replacement caravan is created.
LanguageData.INH_MaintenanceProblem_ResidentUnavailab: The stored original is unavailable for maintenance. Check its status.
LanguageData.INH_MaintenanceProblem_CargoReserved: This food belongs to a transport's reserved cargo and cannot be charged here.
LanguageData.INH_MaintenanceProblem_Unsupported: The stored occupant or food is not supported by this maintenance prototype.
LanguageData.INH_MaintenanceProblem_Pending: An unfinished operation needs recovery before another daily charge.
LanguageData.INH_MaintenanceProblem_Shortage: Not enough eligible food for the daily charge. Maintenance is on hold.
LanguageData.INH_MaintenanceProblem_DayGap: A scheduled day was missed. Maintenance is on hold; missed days are not charged automatically.
LanguageData.INH_MaintenanceProblem_ResidenceChanged: The occupant is no longer stored at this site. This plan has ended.
LanguageData.INH_MaintenanceProblem_Unknown: Maintenance needs attention. Check the occupant, original caravan and available food.
